annotations.title: Is this price a good deal?

description: Use before buying or recommending a specific product at a known price in euros. Give brand and model (and the merchant page if you have it) with the price. Returns 'bon', 'moyen', 'mauvais' or 'inconnu', the price range buyers approved, the usual price they report, how many observations support it and how recent they are, and what stays unknown. Each sampled observation gives its shop, the shop's market and whether it is cross-border for the country asked. Prices of used or refurbished products are left out and counted apart; variant is never compared. In approved_price_range, low, typical and high are quartiles; lowest and highest are the extremes. 'inconnu' means the evidence is too thin: say so rather than guess. Not for categories ('a laptop'): use search_deals.

inputSchema.description: A product and the price someone is about to pay for it.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the price. Anything but EUR returns 'inconnu'.
currency.title: Currency

product.description: Brand and model, e.g. 'Sony WH-1000XM5'. A category is not enough.
product.title: Product

url.description: Merchant product page. Used to recognise the product; never fetched.
